title: Interview: Sales queue staffing and voice limits
story: Aisha is the retail sales manager at Contoso. She wants to improve how calls are handled for Sales.
She has tracked long waits on the Sales queue. The calls come in on Retail Sales – Voice through the Contoso Sales IVR (Microsoft Copilot Studio).

interview.opening: I want to reduce waits in Sales and make sure agents can handle more calls.

topics.ask: How many people do you want on the Sales team during the day?
topics.answer: We should have at least five people on Sales so we can cover busy times.

topics.ask: Should agents be able to handle more than one customer at a time?
topics.answer: Yes. We want agents to be able to handle up to three calls at once.

extras.ask: Do you want to change Enterprise Sales right now?
extras.answer: Not right now. Focus on Sales first.

extras.ask: Are Order Desk hours fine as they are?
extras.answer: Yes. Order Desk can stay the same.
